import re
import sys
import zipfile


def main(path):
    z = zipfile.ZipFile(path)
    names = z.namelist()
    media = [n for n in names if n.startswith("word/media")]
    print("MEDIA:", media)
    for n in media:
        print("  ", n, z.getinfo(n).file_size, "bytes")
    xml = z.read("word/document.xml").decode("utf-8")
    print("tables:", xml.count("<w:tbl>"))
    print("drawings:", xml.count("<w:drawing>"))
    print("hyperlinks:", xml.count("<w:hyperlink"))
    print("bold runs:", xml.count("<w:b/>"), "italic:", xml.count("<w:i/>"),
          "strike:", xml.count("<w:strike"))
    tbl = re.search(r"<w:tbl>.*?</w:tbl>", xml, re.S).group(0)
    rows = re.findall(r"<w:tr[ >].*?</w:tr>", tbl, re.S)
    print("rows:", len(rows))
    for r in rows:
        cells = re.findall(r"<w:tc>.*?</w:tc>", r, re.S)
        texts = ["".join(re.findall(r"<w:t[^>]*>(.*?)</w:t>", c)) for c in cells]
        aligns = re.findall(r'<w:jc w:val="([^"]+)"', r)
        print("  |", " | ".join(texts), "| alignment:", aligns)
    rels = z.read("word/_rels/document.xml.rels").decode("utf-8")
    print("image rels:", [m for m in re.findall(r'Target="([^"]*)"', rels) if "media" in m])
    # extract text of the strike run to confirm the struck value
    for m in re.finditer(r"<w:r>(?:(?!</w:r>).)*<w:strike/>.*?</w:r>", xml, re.S):
        print("struck run text:", "".join(re.findall(r"<w:t[^>]*>(.*?)</w:t>", m.group(0))))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1])
